Born_bin: clustered 2-to-2 physical momenta after unresolved emission is merged
inclusive_criterion: an extra massless gauge boson is unresolved and merged into the Born bin when it is soft (energy below slicing_delta) or collinear (angle below slicing_delta) with an existing physical parton
measurement_function: S maps 2-to-3 events with one unresolved emission onto the same Born 2-to-2 bin; resolved 2-to-3 is a different bin and is not required for this IR-pole test
provenance: METHOD / INFRASTRUCTURE; not an experimental cut
